newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Telecom cut to hold.

text.p: Salomon Brothers downgraded Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd to a hold from a buy after the Israeli company reported lower than expected first quarter earnings.

"We believe that the stock is not expected to trade higher from the current level in the next few quarters, due to negative quarterly comparisons and negative earnings growth in 1997," analyst Victor Halpert said in a report released on Wednesday.
Halpert lowered his 1997 earnings per share estimate to $1.45 from $1.72 and his 1998 estimate to $1.88 from $2.00.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.20 a share, against Salomon's estimate of $0.28 and versus $0.60 in the same period last year.
Operating expenses were higher than expected, amounting to $27.1 million or 23.2 percent of revenue compared with $25.4 million forecast by Salomon.

"Although we had expected that 1997 will be a transitional year for Tadiran, the weakness in Bezeq's orders is greater than we had originally anticipated. Therefore, year to year 1997 is expected to be an especially weak year for Tadiran," the report said.
Tadiran Telecom is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd .
